description: commands/endpoints.py includes raw tokens in ?token= URLs and hybrid_cache.py stores unscrubbed LLM payloads with default umask permissions, carries an unused SQLite index, and runs redundant payload normalizations.
goal: Remove ?token= query-string secret leakage in src/holon_coherence/commands/endpoints.py (keeping it at most 200 lines): never include the raw token in inspector_url or printed endpoint URLs, displaying the local inspector base URL with token-recovery command instructions instead. Harden src/holon_coherence/hybrid_cache.py (keeping it strictly at or below 333 lines and NEVER modifying holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json): enforce 0o700 cache directory and 0o600 SQLite file permissions, scrub sensitive credentials and headers via scrub_sensitive_data before persisting payloads and responses in put(), drop the unused idx_prompt_cache_provider_system_created SQLite index, and avoid redundant normalize_payload calls in put(). Update and add tests in tests/commands/test_endpoints.py and tests/test_hybrid_cache.py. Use zero docstrings and zero comments in all modified or added Python files so tests/test_repo_self_doc.py passes, and NEVER modify holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Exposing tokens in terminal URLs and writing unscrubbed payloads into world-readable SQLite files risks credential leakage, while redundant indexing and normalization slow cache writes.
acceptance_criteria: src/holon_coherence/commands/endpoints.py never emits '?token=' in inspector URLs or formatted endpoint rows and stays at most 200 lines.

src/holon_coherence/hybrid_cache.py enforces 0o700/0o600 permissions, scrubs secrets before SQLite persistence, drops idx_prompt_cache_provider_system_created, eliminates triple normalization in put(), and stays at most 333 lines without modifying holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json.

tests/commands/test_endpoints.py and tests/test_hybrid_cache.py verify secret-free endpoint formatting, restrictive cache permissions, and scrubbed cached payloads with zero docstrings or comments, and 'uv run pytest' plus 'uv run task lint' pass.
